title: Training-Free Knowledge Transfer Across Model Scales through Activation-Guided Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2608.13596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Heterogeneous model fusion seeks to combine models that differ in tasks, initializations, architectures, or scales. We study an underexplored cross-scale setting: improving a small recipient language model with a stronger donor despite substantial architectural mismatch. We ask whether useful capabilities can be transferred without explicit neuron-wise semantic alignment. Building on the observation that truncating a large model to a smaller architecture and injecting it with a tiny mixing weight can already improve the recipient, we propose Activation-Prune-Merge (APM), an activation-guided framework for cross-scale fusion. APM constructs task-conditioned activation maps on the donor, selects salient layers, hidden dimensions, attention heads, and MLP neurons to prune it to the recipient architecture, and injects the resulting donor slice into the original recipient using a micro interpolation coefficient. translated_title: 通过激活引导剪枝实现跨模型规模的无训练知识迁移
translated_abstract: 异构模型融合旨在结合在任务、初始化、架构或规模上有所不同的模型。我们研究了一个尚未充分探索的跨规模设置：在存在显著架构不匹配的情况下，用更强的供体模型改进较小的受体语言模型。我们探究是否可以在没有显式神经元级语义对齐的情况下转移有用能力。基于将大型模型截断为较小架构并注入微小混合权重即可改善受体的观察，我们提出了激活-剪枝-合并（APM），一种用于跨规模融合的激活引导框架。APM在供体上构建任务条件激活图，选择显著层、隐藏维度、注意力头和MLP神经元，将其剪枝为受体架构，并使用微插值系数将所得供体切片注入原始受体。这一公式将...
tldr: 本文提出激活引导的剪枝合并框架（APM），无需训练即可通过任务条件激活图选择供体模型的关键部分并注入受体，实现跨模型规模的高效知识迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an activation-guided pruning-merging framework (APM) that enables training-free knowledge transfer across model scales by selecting key donor components via task-conditioned activation maps and injecting them into the recipient.
